QUOTE: Default (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off) ... That macro is off in the shipped config (`mbedtls_config.h:4124`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as the switch, but it never says the macro is commented out in the shipped config. The "off in the shipped config" remark is about MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC, not about MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY.
